name: New IRB Project Template
subject: Welcome to IRB application for Student Research Projects
response:
Dear {{student_names}},


Welcome to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) Application portal for Student Research Projects.


Please follow the steps below to complete your application


Setting up your portal account

Please visit https://student-irb.m.frappe.cloud/ and sign in with your apu.edu.in email id.


Please bookmark the link to access the portal for all future requirements.

Tutorials for portal - https://drive.google.com/file/d/1C5zb796-K7o6Q8N0Q8AbzegJJKRoFI4y/view?usp=drive_link


Filling your application and submission to Faculty Mentor

Once you log in, you will be directed to the ‘Students' IRB Projects’ page, where you can Click on the project and open the application. You will also be asked to upload your field project proposal, any sample consent forms and survey tools etc. as a single pdf file. All these documents complete your IRB application which you will then need to submit to your Faculty Mentor for approval.


Once your mentor approves the application, this will move to the IRB for review automatically. However, if your mentor asks for a revision, you must revise and resubmit before the deadline.


IRB Review

After your Faculty Mentor approves, the IRB will review your application and will communicate the status to you and your Faculty Mentor. If the IRB asks the student to revise and resubmit their application, you will need to revise your application in light of the feedback and take this forward through your Faculty Mentor to the IRB.


Contact us at research@apu.edu.in/student.irbhelpdesk@apu.edu.in for any assistance you may require for the portal. Kindly include student ID, student name, faculty mentor name, title of project/proposal in your email to us.


IRB Team

subject: IRB Review - Revise and resubmit
response:
Dear {{student_names}},


The IRB has reviewed your application and feedback has been provided by your reviewer.


We request you to login to the IRB portal, review the feedback provided by your reviewer, revise and resubmit the application  within 5 days.


You are expected to discuss the feedback provided by the IRB with your faculty mentor. Once you submit the revised form,  the application will automatically move to IRB.


Regards,

IRB Team
